lines.s: Is this your bike, Tom?
lines.zh: 湯姆，這是你的腳踏車嗎？
lines.en: Is this your bike, Tom?

lines.s: No, mine is blue. That red one is my sister's.
lines.zh: 不是，我的是藍色的。那台紅色的是我妹妹的。
lines.en: No, mine is blue. That red one is my sister's.

lines.s: What does Anna do after school?
lines.zh: 安娜放學後做什麼？
lines.en: What does Anna do after school?

lines.s: She plays tennis with her friend. She doesn't watch TV.
lines.zh: 她和朋友打網球。她不看電視。
lines.en: She plays tennis with her friend. She doesn't watch TV.

lines.s: Do you want an apple?
lines.zh: 你要蘋果嗎？
lines.en: Do you want an apple?

lines.s: No, thanks. Can I have a banana?
lines.zh: 不用，謝謝。我可以吃香蕉嗎？
lines.en: No, thanks. Can I have a banana?

lines.s: What time is the film?
lines.zh: 電影幾點？
lines.en: What time is the film?

lines.s: It starts at half past three. Let's go!
lines.zh: 三點半開始。走吧！
lines.en: It starts at half past three. Let's go!

lines.s: How do you go to work?
lines.zh: 你怎麼去上班？
lines.en: How do you go to work?

lines.s: I go by train. It's fast.
lines.zh: 我搭火車，很快。
lines.en: I go by train. It's fast.

lines.s: You will hear a teacher talking about a school trip.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位老師談學校的校外教學。
lines.en: You will hear a teacher talking about a school trip.

lines.s: Listen, everyone. Our school trip is on Friday. We're going to the zoo. The bus leaves at nine o'clock. Please bring a packed lunch and a hat, because it's going to be sunny. The trip costs six pounds. We'll be back at school at three.
lines.zh: 大家聽好。我們的校外教學在星期五，要去動物園。巴士九點出發。請帶便當和帽子，因為會很晴朗。費用六英鎊。我們三點回到學校。
lines.en: Listen, everyone. Our school trip is on Friday. We're going to the zoo. The bus leaves at nine o'clock. Please bring a packed lunch and a hat, because it's going to be sunny. The trip costs six pounds. We'll be back at school at three.

lines.s: You will hear Ben talking to his friend Lucy about the weekend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到班和朋友露西談週末。
lines.en: You will hear Ben talking to his friend Lucy about the weekend.

lines.s: Hi Lucy. What did you do at the weekend?
lines.zh: 嗨，露西。妳週末做了什麼？
lines.en: Hi Lucy. What did you do at the weekend?

lines.s: On Saturday I went to my cousin's house. It was her birthday.
lines.zh: 星期六我去了表妹家，那天是她的生日。
lines.en: On Saturday I went to my cousin's house. It was her birthday.

lines.s: Nice! How old is she?
lines.zh: 真好！她幾歲？
lines.en: Nice! How old is she?

lines.s: She's ten. We had a party in the garden. Then on Sunday I stayed at home and did my homework.
lines.zh: 她十歲。我們在花園辦派對。星期天我在家寫作業。
lines.en: She's ten. We had a party in the garden. Then on Sunday I stayed at home and did my homework.

lines.s: I played football on Sunday. We won!
lines.zh: 我星期天踢足球，我們贏了！
lines.en: I played football on Sunday. We won!

lines.s: Great! Are you playing next Sunday too?
lines.zh: 太棒了！下星期天你也要踢嗎？
lines.en: Great! Are you playing next Sunday too?

lines.s: No, next Sunday I'm going to the cinema with my dad.
lines.zh: 不，下星期天我要和爸爸去看電影。
lines.en: No, next Sunday I'm going to the cinema with my dad.

ask.s: Where did Lucy go on Saturday?
ask.en: Where did Lucy go on Saturday?

ask.s: What did Lucy do on Sunday?
ask.en: What did Lucy do on Sunday?

ask.s: What will Ben do next Sunday?
ask.en: What will Ben do next Sunday?

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about her pet.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的寵物。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her pet.

lines.s: I've got a rabbit. He's white and his name is Snow. He eats carrots every day.
lines.zh: 我有一隻兔子，白色的，叫小雪。牠每天吃紅蘿蔔。
lines.en: I've got a rabbit. He's white and his name is Snow. He eats carrots every day.

lines.s: You will hear a man in a shop.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士在商店裡。
lines.en: You will hear a man in a shop.

lines.s: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt? Twelve pounds? OK, I'll take it.
lines.zh: 不好意思，這件 T 恤多少錢？十二英鎊？好，我要買。
lines.en: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt? Twelve pounds? OK, I'll take it.

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking about his day.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談他的一天。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about his day.

lines.s: Today I got up late, so I didn't have breakfast. I was very hungry at school!
lines.zh: 今天我起晚了，所以沒吃早餐。我在學校好餓！
lines.en: Today I got up late, so I didn't have breakfast. I was very hungry at school!

ask.s: Why didn't the boy have breakfast?
ask.en: Why didn't the boy have breakfast?

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking about the weather.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士談天氣。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about the weather.

lines.s: It's raining now, but it's going to be sunny this afternoon.
lines.zh: 現在在下雨，但今天下午會放晴。
lines.en: It's raining now, but it's going to be sunny this afternoon.

ask.s: What will the weather be like this afternoon?
ask.en: What will the weather be like this afternoon?

lines.s: You will hear a girl phoning her friend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩打電話給朋友。
lines.en: You will hear a girl phoning her friend.

lines.s: Hi Jo! Can you come to my house on Saturday? We can make a cake.
lines.zh: 嗨，裘！星期六可以來我家嗎？我們可以做蛋糕。
lines.en: Hi Jo! Can you come to my house on Saturday? We can make a cake.

ask.s: What does the girl want to do on Saturday?
ask.en: What does the girl want to do on Saturday?

lines.s: Have you got a pet, Emma?
lines.zh: 艾瑪，妳有養寵物嗎？
lines.en: Have you got a pet, Emma?

lines.s: Yes, I've got a dog. He's brown and very friendly.
lines.zh: 有，我有一隻狗。牠是棕色的，很友善。
lines.en: Yes, I've got a dog. He's brown and very friendly.

lines.s: Do you like swimming, Jack?
lines.zh: 傑克，你喜歡游泳嗎？
lines.en: Do you like swimming, Jack?

lines.s: It's OK, but I love football. I play every day.
lines.zh: 還好，但我很愛足球，每天都踢。
lines.en: It's OK, but I love football. I play every day.

lines.s: What would you like to drink?
lines.zh: 妳想喝什麼？
lines.en: What would you like to drink?

lines.s: Orange juice, please. I don't like milk.
lines.zh: 請給我柳橙汁。我不喜歡牛奶。
lines.en: Orange juice, please. I don't like milk.

lines.s: Where's Dad?
lines.zh: 爸爸在哪裡？
lines.en: Where's Dad?

lines.s: He's in the garden. He's playing with the dog.
lines.zh: 他在花園，在跟狗玩。
lines.en: He's in the garden. He's playing with the dog.

lines.s: What did you buy?
lines.zh: 妳買了什麼？
lines.en: What did you buy?

lines.s: A new bag for school. My old one is too small.
lines.zh: 一個上學用的新包包。我的舊包包太小了。
lines.en: A new bag for school. My old one is too small.

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking about a sports club.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士介紹運動社團。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about a sports club.

lines.s: Hello! Come to our tennis club. It's for children from eight to twelve. Lessons are on Tuesday afternoons at four o'clock, in the park. You need to bring a bottle of water. Each lesson costs three pounds. My name is Mrs Black.
lines.zh: 大家好！來參加我們的網球社吧。適合八到十二歲的孩子。每星期二下午四點在公園上課。要帶一瓶水。每堂課三英鎊。我是布萊克太太。
lines.en: Hello! Come to our tennis club. It's for children from eight to twelve. Lessons are on Tuesday afternoons at four o'clock, in the park. You need to bring a bottle of water. Each lesson costs three pounds. My name is Mrs Black.

lines.s: You will hear Sam talking to his mum about his new friend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到山姆和媽媽談他的新朋友。
lines.en: You will hear Sam talking to his mum about his new friend.

lines.s: Who is your new friend, Sam?
lines.zh: 山姆，你的新朋友是誰？
lines.en: Who is your new friend, Sam?

lines.s: His name is Omar. He's from Egypt. He's in my class.
lines.zh: 他叫奧馬，來自埃及。他和我同班。
lines.en: His name is Omar. He's from Egypt. He's in my class.

lines.s: Does he speak English?
lines.zh: 他會說英文嗎？
lines.en: Does he speak English?

lines.s: Yes, very well! He likes drawing, like me. And he's got two sisters.
lines.zh: 會，說得很好！他和我一樣喜歡畫畫。他有兩個姐妹。
lines.en: Yes, very well! He likes drawing, like me. And he's got two sisters.

lines.s: Do you want to ask him to our house?
lines.zh: 你想請他來我們家嗎？
lines.en: Do you want to ask him to our house?

lines.s: Yes, please! Can he come on Friday after school? We can play computer games.
lines.zh: 好啊！他可以星期五放學後來嗎？我們可以玩電腦遊戲。
lines.en: Yes, please! Can he come on Friday after school? We can play computer games.

options.t: They are in the same class.

ask.s: What do Sam and Omar both like?
ask.en: What do Sam and Omar both like?

ask.s: How many sisters has Omar got?
ask.en: How many sisters has Omar got?

ask.s: When can Omar come to Sam's house?
ask.en: When can Omar come to Sam's house?

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking about his family.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談他的家人。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about his family.

lines.s: There are five people in my family: my mum, my dad, my two brothers and me.
lines.zh: 我家有五個人：媽媽、爸爸、兩個哥哥和我。
lines.en: There are five people in my family: my mum, my dad, my two brothers and me.

ask.s: How many people are in the boy's family?
ask.en: How many people are in the boy's family?

lines.s: You will hear a woman at a café.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士在咖啡館。
lines.en: You will hear a woman at a café.

lines.s: Can I have a cheese sandwich and a cup of coffee, please?
lines.zh: 請給我一份起司三明治和一杯咖啡。
lines.en: Can I have a cheese sandwich and a cup of coffee, please?

ask.s: What does the woman want to eat?
ask.en: What does the woman want to eat?

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about school.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談學校。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about school.

lines.s: My favourite day is Monday, because we have art and music!
lines.zh: 我最喜歡星期一，因為我們有美術和音樂課！
lines.en: My favourite day is Monday, because we have art and music!

ask.s: Why does the girl like Monday?
ask.zh: 女孩為什麼喜歡星期一？
ask.en: Why does the girl like Monday?

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about his holiday.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士談他的假期。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about his holiday.

lines.s: Next summer we're going to Italy. We're going to stay for two weeks.
lines.zh: 明年夏天我們要去義大利，要待兩個星期。
lines.en: Next summer we're going to Italy. We're going to stay for two weeks.

ask.s: How long will they stay in Italy?
ask.zh: 他們會在義大利待多久？
ask.en: How long will they stay in Italy?

lines.s: You will hear a boy asking his teacher a question.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩問老師問題。
lines.en: You will hear a boy asking his teacher a question.

lines.s: Excuse me, Miss Hall. I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow one, please?
lines.zh: 霍爾老師，不好意思，我找不到我的鉛筆。可以借我一枝嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, Miss Hall. I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow one, please?

panels: a sunny day at a beach
a plate of chicken and rice
a woman teacher in front of a class
a cinema with seats and a big screen; no writing, no numbers anywhere

lines.s: What's the weather like today?
lines.zh: 今天天氣怎麼樣？
lines.en: What's the weather like today?

lines.s: It's raining. Take your umbrella!
lines.zh: 在下雨。帶傘！
lines.en: It's raining. Take your umbrella!

lines.s: What's for dinner, Mum?
lines.zh: 媽，晚餐吃什麼？
lines.en: What's for dinner, Mum?

lines.s: Chicken and rice. We had pizza yesterday.
lines.zh: 雞肉飯。昨天吃過披薩了。
lines.en: Chicken and rice. We had pizza yesterday.

lines.s: What does your mum do?
lines.zh: 你媽媽做什麼工作？
lines.en: What does your mum do?

lines.s: She's a teacher at my school. She teaches maths.
lines.zh: 她是我們學校的老師，教數學。
lines.en: She's a teacher at my school. She teaches maths.

lines.s: Can you play an instrument?
lines.zh: 妳會樂器嗎？
lines.en: Can you play an instrument?

lines.s: Yes, I play the piano. I want to learn the guitar too.
lines.zh: 會，我彈鋼琴。我也想學吉他。
lines.en: Yes, I play the piano. I want to learn the guitar too.

lines.s: Where are you going this afternoon?
lines.zh: 你今天下午要去哪裡？
lines.en: Where are you going this afternoon?

lines.s: To the swimming pool with my brother.
lines.zh: 和哥哥去游泳池。
lines.en: To the swimming pool with my brother.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about a new shop.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士介紹一家新商店。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about a new shop.

lines.s: Come to our new bookshop in King Street! We open on Monday the fifth of May. We sell books for children and adults. On Saturdays there is a story time for children at eleven o'clock. Coffee costs two pounds in our café. Our phone number is 0161 496 0000.
lines.zh: 來國王街我們的新書店吧！我們五月五日星期一開幕，賣兒童和成人的書。每星期六十一點有兒童故事時間。我們咖啡館的咖啡兩英鎊。電話是 0161 496 0000。
lines.en: Come to our new bookshop in King Street! We open on Monday the fifth of May. We sell books for children and adults. On Saturdays there is a story time for children at eleven o'clock. Coffee costs two pounds in our café. Our phone number is 0161 496 0000.

lines.s: You will hear Kate talking to her friend Harry about a party.
lines.zh: 你會聽到凱特和朋友哈利談一場派對。
lines.en: You will hear Kate talking to her friend Harry about a party.

lines.s: Hi Kate. Are you coming to Jake's party?
lines.zh: 嗨，凱特。妳要去傑克的派對嗎？
lines.en: Hi Kate. Are you coming to Jake's party?

lines.s: Yes! It's on Saturday, isn't it?
lines.zh: 要！是星期六對吧？
lines.en: Yes! It's on Saturday, isn't it?

lines.s: Yes, at seven o'clock, at his house. Everyone is going to wear something blue.
lines.zh: 對，七點，在他家。大家都要穿藍色的衣服。
lines.en: Yes, at seven o'clock, at his house. Everyone is going to wear something blue.

lines.s: Oh! I've got a blue dress. What are you going to give Jake?
lines.zh: 喔！我有一件藍色洋裝。你要送傑克什麼？
lines.en: Oh! I've got a blue dress. What are you going to give Jake?

lines.s: A football. He loves football. And you?
lines.zh: 一顆足球。他很愛足球。妳呢？
lines.en: A football. He loves football. And you?

lines.s: I'm going to make him a card and buy some chocolate.
lines.zh: 我要做一張卡片給他，再買一些巧克力。
lines.en: I'm going to make him a card and buy some chocolate.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about her bedroom.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的房間。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her bedroom.

lines.s: My bedroom is small, but I love it. The walls are green and I have a big window.
lines.zh: 我的房間很小，但我很喜歡。牆是綠色的，有一扇大窗戶。
lines.en: My bedroom is small, but I love it. The walls are green and I have a big window.

lines.s: You will hear a man at a train station.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士在火車站。
lines.en: You will hear a man at a train station.

lines.s: A ticket to Oxford, please. Just one way. How much is that?
lines.zh: 請給我一張到牛津的票，單程。多少錢？
lines.en: A ticket to Oxford, please. Just one way. How much is that?

ask.s: Where does the man want to go?
ask.en: Where does the man want to go?

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談他的週末。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.

lines.s: On Saturday I went to the park with my dog. On Sunday I visited my grandparents.
lines.zh: 星期六我帶狗去公園。星期天我去看爺爺奶奶。
lines.en: On Saturday I went to the park with my dog. On Sunday I visited my grandparents.

ask.s: What did the boy do on Sunday?
ask.en: What did the boy do on Sunday?

lines.s: You will hear a woman talking to her son.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士和兒子說話。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking to her son.

lines.s: Tom, it's cold today. Wear your coat and your hat, please.
lines.zh: 湯姆，今天很冷。請穿外套、戴帽子。
lines.en: Tom, it's cold today. Wear your coat and your hat, please.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about her best friend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她最好的朋友。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her best friend.

lines.s: My best friend is Mia. She's tall and she has long black hair. She's very kind.
lines.zh: 我最好的朋友是米亞。她很高，有一頭黑色長髮，人很好。
lines.en: My best friend is Mia. She's tall and she has long black hair. She's very kind.

ask.zh: 米亞的頭髮是什麼樣子？

a coat hanging on a hook

lines.s: Have you got a pet, Emma?
lines.zh: 艾瑪，妳有寵物嗎？
lines.en: Have you got a pet, Emma?

lines.s: Yes, I have a rabbit. She is white and very small.
lines.zh: 有，我有一隻兔子，白色的，很小。
lines.en: Yes, I have a rabbit. She is white and very small.

lines.s: Do you like swimming, Dan?
lines.zh: 丹，你喜歡游泳嗎？
lines.en: Do you like swimming, Dan?

lines.s: Not really. I play football in the park every day.
lines.zh: 不太喜歡。我每天在公園踢足球。
lines.en: Not really. I play football in the park every day.

lines.s: What would you like to drink?
lines.zh: 妳想喝什麼？
lines.en: What would you like to drink?

lines.s: Tea, please. I don't like milk.
lines.zh: 請給我茶。我不喜歡牛奶。
lines.en: Tea, please. I don't like milk.

lines.s: Where is Dad?
lines.zh: 爸爸在哪裡？
lines.en: Where is Dad?

lines.s: He's in the garden. He's watering the flowers.
lines.zh: 他在花園裡澆花。
lines.en: He's in the garden. He's watering the flowers.

lines.s: Mum, I can't find my school bag!
lines.zh: 媽，我找不到我的書包！
lines.en: Mum, I can't find my school bag!

lines.s: It's on the chair, next to your coat.
lines.zh: 在椅子上，你的外套旁邊。
lines.en: It's on the chair, next to your coat.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about a new swimming club.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士介紹新的游泳社。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about a new swimming club.

lines.s: Hello, everyone. There's a new swimming club for children at the sports centre. It's on Tuesday afternoons, from four to five. It's for children from six to ten years old. Please bring a towel. The club costs three pounds each week. Our teacher's name is Mr Green.
lines.zh: 大家好。運動中心有一個新的兒童游泳社，在星期二下午四點到五點，給六到十歲的孩子參加。請帶毛巾。每週三英鎊。老師是格林先生。
lines.en: Hello, everyone. There's a new swimming club for children at the sports centre. It's on Tuesday afternoons, from four to five. It's for children from six to ten years old. Please bring a towel. The club costs three pounds each week. Our teacher's name is Mr Green.

lines.s: You will hear Amy talking to her friend Max about a party.
lines.zh: 你會聽到艾咪和朋友麥克斯談一個派對。
lines.en: You will hear Amy talking to her friend Max about a party.

lines.s: Max, it's my birthday on Saturday. Can you come to my party?
lines.zh: 麥克斯，星期六是我生日，你能來我的派對嗎？
lines.en: Max, it's my birthday on Saturday. Can you come to my party?

lines.s: Yes, I can! Where is it?
lines.zh: 可以！在哪裡？
lines.en: Yes, I can! Where is it?

lines.s: It's at my house. It starts at two o'clock.
lines.zh: 在我家，兩點開始。
lines.en: It's at my house. It starts at two o'clock.

lines.s: Great. What do you want for your birthday?
lines.zh: 太好了。妳生日想要什麼？
lines.en: Great. What do you want for your birthday?

lines.s: I love books. Or you can make me a card!
lines.zh: 我喜歡書。或者你可以做張卡片給我！
lines.en: I love books. Or you can make me a card!

lines.s: OK. Can my sister come too? She's eight.
lines.zh: 好。我妹妹也能來嗎？她八歲。
lines.en: OK. Can my sister come too? She's eight.

lines.s: Of course! My mum is making pizza for everyone.
lines.zh: 當然！我媽媽要幫大家做披薩。
lines.en: Of course! My mum is making pizza for everyone.

ask.s: What time does the party start?
ask.en: What time does the party start?

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking about his teacher.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談他的老師。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about his teacher.

lines.s: My teacher is Miss Hill. She's tall and she has long red hair. She's very funny.
lines.zh: 我的老師是希爾小姐，她很高，有一頭紅色長髮，很有趣。
lines.en: My teacher is Miss Hill. She's tall and she has long red hair. She's very funny.

ask.s: What colour is Miss Hill's hair?
ask.zh: 希爾小姐的頭髮是什麼顏色？
ask.en: What colour is Miss Hill's hair?

lines.s: You will hear a woman at a train station.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士在火車站。
lines.en: You will hear a woman at a train station.

lines.s: One ticket to London, please. Return. Is that eighteen pounds? Thank you.
lines.zh: 一張到倫敦的票，來回票。十八英鎊嗎？謝謝。
lines.en: One ticket to London, please. Return. Is that eighteen pounds? Thank you.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about her weekend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的週末。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her weekend.

lines.s: On Sunday I went to the park with my dad. We had a picnic and played tennis.
lines.zh: 星期天我和爸爸去公園，我們野餐還打網球。
lines.en: On Sunday I went to the park with my dad. We had a picnic and played tennis.

ask.s: Who did the girl go to the park with?
ask.en: Who did the girl go to the park with?

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about his breakfast.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士談他的早餐。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about his breakfast.

lines.s: I always have eggs and toast for breakfast. I don't drink coffee in the morning.
lines.zh: 我早餐總是吃蛋和吐司，早上不喝咖啡。
lines.en: I always have eggs and toast for breakfast. I don't drink coffee in the morning.

ask.s: What does the man eat for breakfast?
ask.en: What does the man eat for breakfast?

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking to her brother.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩和哥哥說話。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking to her brother.

lines.s: It's very cold today, Paul. Take your scarf and your gloves!
lines.zh: 保羅，今天很冷，帶你的圍巾和手套！
lines.en: It's very cold today, Paul. Take your scarf and your gloves!
